GATE_1_phase0_configuration.text: Exact supplied title preserved verbatim in every location (cover, title page, copyright, TOC, headers, metadata)
Eponym Audit completed with resolution table; every eponym in title and planned headings has a confirmed descriptive replacement before TOC lock
Dated trademark report present; established medical-textbook series collision check done; risk rating CLEAR or explained low-confusion CAUTION
Amazon marketplace locked; book language locked; guideline jurisdiction assumption stated
Learner level and profile confirmed; page floors noted (min 23 pages/chapter, 400-550 total, 10-20 chapters)
R2 dual-source verification requirement confirmed and documented in configuration summary
NO-PRACTICE-QUESTIONS operator directive confirmed and documented
Hard Rule 22 (no diagrams, schematics, flowcharts) confirmed and documented
Book Identity Code declared with +OV-MEDT suffix; collision-checked against all prior catalog codes; Forbidden Repetition Rule (Axis A+B+D trio) satisfied
PRIMARY + ACCENT palette assigned, confirmed catalog-unique, recorded in catalog log
6-8 KDP-compliant subtitle options in book language; recommended chosen; title+subtitle under 200 characters
3-5 pen names in First M. Surname format only; zero credentials of any kind
Type Proceed presented at end of Phase 0 before any generation

GATE_2_toc_architecture.text: TOC in book language; chapter count 10-20; page arithmetic confirms 400-550 achievable at 23 pages min per chapter
Every chapter blueprint budgets at least 13,000 words of body prose before images, captions, and feature boxes
Every chapter title and numbered section heading reviewed; zero eponyms as primary terms
Case-based structure confirmed for every chapter: scenario opener, mechanistic body, case-resolution close
4-6 objectives per chapter; Bloom Apply/Analyze/Evaluate dominant; traceable to content sections not questions
3-5 feature-box types selected and custom-named from the Medical Feature Box System; Red Flag Alert subject to 100% floor
Per-subchapter photorealistic image planned for every numbered subchapter; type is teaching model or clinical setting, never diagram/schematic/flowchart
Back matter confirmed: Drug Class Reference, Normal Values, Clinical Glossary, References (AMA or APA 7), Index
No practice/review/graded items in any chapter outline or back-matter plan
Type Proceed presented before front-matter generation

GATE_3_per_chapter.text: Chapter is at least 23 pages when clinical exposition, feature boxes, and per-subchapter images are counted
Chapter opens with a plausible, pathophysiologically coherent fictional clinical scenario per Axis B
Learning Objectives Box: PRIMARY tint + solid border, bold PRIMARY header, 4-6 numbered Bloom-verb objectives, all traceable, none vague
No practice/review/NCLEX/USMLE/knowledge-check/graded items anywhere in the chapter
No eponyms in any heading, subheading, box header, figure caption, or table title; consistent with Phase 0 table
All drugs named generic [pharmacological class] at first use; no brand/trade names as primary identifiers
Every dosing-context passage immediately followed by the complete formulary verification sentence, not abbreviated/moved/omitted
R2 dual-source verification completed for all contraindications, red-flags, interactions, criteria, recommendations; unresolved marked with CITATION NEEDED placeholders and user notified
100% accuracy floor confirmed for contraindications, red-flag lists, interactions, dosing context; no approximated high-stakes claims
Every numbered subchapter carries exactly one photorealistic image, six-part recipe applied, Safe-Vocabulary framing line and substitutions present, no diagram/schematic/flowchart
Verbatim label set is 8-12 maximum; split into two images if more accuracy is needed
Every figure referenced by number in prose; caption below in Axis H style; pure white background for teaching models; alt text present
Numbered section headings bold in ACCENT color; correct H2/H3 hierarchy
Body justified; no em dashes anywhere; no AI-register filler vocabulary
Condensed disclaimer reminder present at chapter opening where chapter contains dosing context, emergency criteria, or contraindication lists
Chapter close resolves the opening scenario per Axis G with substantive synthesis and a forward bridge
Chapter appended to cumulative manuscript; Type Proceed presented before next chapter

GATE_4_release.text: Trim 8.5 x 11 in; margins 0.7 in all sides
Times New Roman at correct point sizes; real Word Heading styles; Word TOC field populated, updateable, dot leaders, right-aligned page numbers
No visible front-matter page numbers; Preface begins Arabic page 1; numbering continuous to end; front matter in mandatory sequence
Full clinical disclaimer on copyright page with all mandatory OV-MEDT elements; condensed reminder at every dosing/emergency chapter opening
Total pages within 400-550; every chapter at least 23; chapter count 10-20
No practice/NCLEX/USMLE/graded items anywhere in front matter, chapters, boxes, or back matter
Zero eponyms as primary terms in any heading, subheading, box header, caption, table title, or glossary primary entry
Zero brand/trade names as primary drug identifiers; generic [class] format at first use per chapter
Every dosing-context passage in every chapter and appendix carries the complete formulary verification sentence
All contraindications, red-flag lists, interactions, and diagnostic criteria dual-source confirmed; all placeholders resolved or clearly marked
Every numbered subchapter has its compliant photorealistic image; no diagrams/schematics/flowcharts anywhere; captions below and alt text; referenced by number
PRIMARY in all Learning Objectives boxes; ACCENT on all numbered section headings and all table header rows; no third color
Book Identity Code with +OV-MEDT confirmed unique and recorded against title, pen name, domain, marketplace, language, edition, account
No em dashes anywhere in the manuscript
Document opens cleanly; TOC updates without error; no clipped tables, stretched images, broken headings, or orphaned titles; rendered page by page and inspected
